Pierre Damas Bel was a physiology and neuroscience student at Wright State who had dreams of going to medical school. He was a bright student and cherished community member.

After the Supreme Court allowed Trump to rescind temporary protected status for Haitians, Pierre and dozens of Haitians in Springfield, Ohio were forced to wear ankle monitors. Those close to him say he felt humiliated, was bullied for it, and “treated like an animal.”

ICE’s cruelty is killing people.

Brian Morales, a 25-year-old U.S. citizen, was riding in a vehicle that was stopped by police in April. After the police called ICE, Brian explained to immigration officials that he is a U.S. citizen, born in Colorado, and even offered to show his birth certificate. DHS disputed this and DEPORTED him to Mexico.

MONTHS later, he is finally back in the United States.

Brian is just one of several U.S. citizens who have been kidnapped under the guise of immigration enforcement. This needs to stop.
